_comment: Starting Water presentation tuning against the owner Veilfall board. Installed terrain family reused. These are unjudged initial numbers, not visual acceptance.

terrain._comment: Slope rise/run above 0.65 exposes pale rock; lowest three metres use warm shore earth. Vegetation and stone silhouettes must carry island identity.

water._comment: Existing Compatibility-safe water shader uses a baked height texture for shoreline foam, never depth readback. Whole realm height texture spacing4m initially; shore detail assessed in actual frames.

view._comment: The first shore must show Veilfall at roughly4km, so camera far clip exceeds realm extent. Dense ground vegetation remains local and baked.
